metric_catalog.name: Service revenue
metric_catalog.description: Modeled labor plus parts revenue recognized on closed service work orders.
metric_catalog.caveat: Synthetic modeled revenue; not audited accounting revenue.

metric_catalog.name: Open service backlog
metric_catalog.description: Work orders not yet closed; a count, not a monetary backlog valuation.
metric_catalog.caveat: No SLA or aging threshold is implied.

metric_catalog.name: Average days to close
metric_catalog.description: Average elapsed days recorded for closed work orders.
metric_catalog.caveat: Uses generated elapsed days; excludes open work orders.

metric_catalog.name: Fleet utilization
metric_catalog.description: Unique rented equipment-days divided by modeled available equipment-days.
metric_catalog.caveat: Availability is assumed for every asset-day; maintenance and out-of-service periods are not modeled.

metric_catalog.name: Parts fill rate
metric_catalog.description: Weighted share of requested parts units fulfilled.
metric_catalog.caveat: Weighted by units; not an order-line on-time fill measure.

metric_catalog.name: Modeled rental revenue
metric_catalog.description: Synthetic contract revenue modeled from rental days and daily rate.
metric_catalog.caveat: Not a ledger or invoice amount.

quality.name: Work order key uniqueness
quality.description: Every work_order_id is populated and unique.

quality.name: Controlled work order status
quality.description: Only Open, In Progress, or Closed are accepted.

quality.name: Nonnegative service revenue
quality.description: Labor and parts revenue cannot be negative.

quality.name: Open orders carry no recognized revenue
quality.description: Open and in-progress work orders must not carry recognized service revenue.

quality.name: Parts quantity bounds
quality.description: Fulfilled quantity must be between zero and requested quantity.

quality.name: Equipment referential integrity
quality.description: Every work order and rental contract resolves to a Gold equipment dimension row.

quality.name: Branch referential integrity
quality.description: All operational facts resolve to a conformed branch dimension.
quality.observed: Work orders, parts orders, rental contracts, and fleet days

quality.name: Service revenue reconciliation
quality.description: Closed-work-order revenue agrees between Silver source components and Gold measure input.

quality.name: Fleet-day grain uniqueness
quality.description: There is exactly one row per equipment asset and calendar date.

quality.name: Fleet utilization bounds
quality.description: Unique rented asset-days cannot exceed modeled available asset-days.
